b2b_drafts.subject: Healthcare enterprise $6M token overrun — AgentShield prevents this in <1ms
b2b_drafts.body: Saw your case study on the healthcare enterprise that consumed 1 trillion tokens in 6 months. That's exactly the scenario AgentShield was built for. It's a per-transaction spend firewall: each API call is evaluated against configurable rules (transaction limits, daily caps, velocity) before it executes. Sub-millisecond evaluation, pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies. Would love to explore whether AgentShield could integrate with Portal26's Shadow AI Discovery Engine as an enforcement layer.
